comments.text:
There are ethic Azerbaijanis with light hair and light-colored eyes, just as there are in other countries. Physical features can vary depending on whether you’re talking about the northern or southern part of the country.
Saying that all Azerbaijanis have dark hair and brown eyes is just like saying that all Italians or Iranians have dark hair and brown eyes.

Claims of absolute intolerance toward Armenians also do not reflect reality. 
Unlike Armenia, which has no Azerbaijani or Turkish citizens, Azerbaijan is home to more than 30,000 ethnic Armenian citizens.
